prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: character design reference for a Korean-learning mobile story RPG, NOT a UI screenshot. Premium sculpted 3D storybook rendering, soft neutral warm studio key light, material-specific detail. TRUE transparent RGBA background, no backdrop, no floor, no contact shadow plate, no checkerboard drawn into pixels, no captions, no text, no borders. Each view isolated with generous transparent gaps, no overlap, fully visible extremities. Same individual in every panel; never redesign identity. This is a production target reference, not proof of a measured 3D mesh. Create one WIDE reference sheet with THREE full-body views of TAEGO, the SAME mature white tiger: front standing, left side standing, three-quarter standing. Images1-2 control same adult face, blue eyes, pink-brown nose, white fur/charcoal stripe pattern; image3 exact THREE-curl teal/gold badge on same anatomical chest side. Same rounded sculpted fur clumps, no different stripe character from panel to panel, not a cub, not muscular photoreal wildlife. Base targets withers80cm, nose-rump120cm, tail85cm, preserve adult silhouette. Four legs and one long tail each. Slightly softened attentive eyes with living gaze, NOT identical vacant glare, no human smile, teeth, eyebrows, horns, wings, mane, aura or weapons. Body dimensions same in all three views; preserve badge position anatomically, do not mirror stripes.

Make all eight unmistakably different, not eight identical stares. Preserve white fur, original face stripe map, pink-brown nose and natural whiskers. No human eyebrows, human lips, tears, speech bubbles, cartoon grins, exposed teeth, predatory snarls, aura or color changes. No added horns/wings/mane. Badge can be below crop, do not invent a partial two-curl badge.

Badge on chest torso, not wing. Rear view has no badge. Keep full long wings/tail. Actual TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no floor/shadow/backdrop/checkerboard/text.
